task: minimize surrogate MAE (eV), train_frac = 1.0, noise via random mae_rank

settings_and_versions.surrogate: mae RandomForestRegressor (100 trees) from surrogate_models.pkl (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.7694268), exported with scikit-learn 1.0.2 / Python 3.10 and evaluated with a numpy traversal (max abs difference to model.predict = 0.0 on 600 test inputs)
settings_and_versions.integer_handling: all 20 numeric hyperparameters searched as continuous, the 10 integer ones rounded before evaluation, for every method
settings_and_versions.noise: each observed value uses mae_rank ~ U(0, 1); reported value uses mae_rank = 0.5
settings_and_versions.random: uniform in the box, rejection of infeasible points (numpy 2.5.3)
settings_and_versions.sobol: scipy.stats.qmc.Sobol(d=23, scramble=True, seed), 512 points, infeasible points rejected, first 50 feasible kept (scipy 1.18.1); categoricals by binning the unit interval
settings_and_versions.lhs: scipy.stats.qmc.LatinHypercube(d=23, seed), 256 points, infeasible points rejected, first 50 feasible kept (scipy 1.18.1)
settings_and_versions.grid: full-factorial grid with 3 levels (lower bound, midpoint, upper bound) per numeric hyperparameter times all 12 categorical combinations (about 4.2e10 points); 50 distinct feasible grid points drawn uniformly at random, i.e. a random order of the constraint-filtered grid
settings_and_versions.ga: pymoo 0.6.2 GA, pop_size 10, 10 offspring per generation (5 generations = 50 evaluations), default tournament selection, SBX crossover, polynomial mutation, duplicate elimination; constraints enforced by a repair operator (sort betas1/betas2, rescale emb_scaler and pos_scaler to sum to 1 when above 1); categoricals encoded as binned continuous genes
settings_and_versions.ax: ax-platform 1.3.1 Client API, 10 Sobol points then the default BoTorch modular generator (SingleTaskGP, qLogNEI), native linear constraints, categoricals as Ax choice parameters; acquisition optimizer reduced to num_restarts 4, raw_samples 256 (Ax default 20 and 1024) for compute time
settings_and_versions.ax_saasbo: ax-platform 1.3.1, 10 Sobol points then BoTorch modular generator with SaasFullyBayesianSingleTaskGP (NUTS via NumPyro: warmup_steps 128, num_samples 64, thinning 16, so 4 posterior samples), qLogNEI, num_restarts 4, raw_samples 256
settings_and_versions.bofire: bofire 0.5.0, 10 points from RandomStrategy (polytope sampling respecting the linear constraints), then SoboStrategy with qLogEI, BotorchOptimizer n_restarts 4, n_raw_samples 256 (defaults 20 and 1024), native LinearInequalityConstraint
settings_and_versions.hardware: 4 shared CPU cores, no GPU, one thread per campaign

notes.stopping: Ax, Ax + SAASBO and BoFire campaigns were stopped at 21:20 UTC (compute deadline, 4 shared CPUs) before reaching 50 evaluations; curves are truncated at the evaluation count reached by all included seeds of that method, and panel (b) compares all methods at the largest budget every method reached
notes.constraint_tolerance_stops: three campaigns ended early because an SLSQP proposal violated a linear constraint by 1e-9 to 8e-9, which tripped a 1e-9 feasibility assertion in the script (tolerance since relaxed to 1e-6): ax seed 0 after 27 evaluations, ax seed 2 after 24, bofire seed 0 after 17
notes.inclusion_rule: seeds with fewer than 20 evaluations were excluded (bofire seed 0, 17 evaluations)
notes.wall_time: wall times include heavy CPU contention (8 campaigns plus other jobs on 4 cores) and are not a fair speed comparison
